title: Zesty Malay Chicken Soup
description: A savory, low-glycemic chicken soup with pickled cucumber, lemongrass, and a tangy tamarind kick, perfect for a quick hangover cure.
instructions: Heat a pot over medium heat and add the water, ginger, garlic, and lemongrass, then bring to a gentle boil.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the chicken and set aside, then strain the broth to remove solids.
Return the broth to the pot, stir in coconut milk, tamarind paste, and fish sauce, and bring to a simmer.
Add the pickled cucumber slices and let the soup cook for another 5 minutes to meld the flavors.
Shred the cooked chicken and return it to the pot, seasoning with lime juice and red chili flakes.
Simmer for an additional 2 minutes to warm the shredded chicken and integrate the spices.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and an extra squeeze of lime if desired.
